newsitem.title: USA: First Chicago NBD to redeem pfd stock.
newsitem.headline: First Chicago NBD to redeem pfd stock.

text.p: First Chicago NBD Corp said Friday its directors authorized the redemption on April 1, 1997 of all shares outstanding of the company's 5-3/4 percent cumulative convertible preferred stock, series B.

The redemption also covers the related redemption of all outstanding depositary shares representing a one-hundredth interest in a share of the series B convertible preferred at a redemption price of $51.725 per depositary share, plus an accrued and unpaid dividend of $0.71875 per share.

Holders of the depositary shares have the right until March 25, 1997 to elect to convert each depositary share into 1.6876 shares of First Chicago NBD comon stock. After that time, depositary shares holders will have the right to receive on April 1 only the redemption price of $51.725 per share, plus accrued and unpaid dividends.

Holders who convert their depositary shares into shares of First Chicago NBD common stock by the end of the day on March 7, 1997, will be entitled to receive the regular quarterly dividend payment on the common stock of $0.40 per common share payable on April 1, 1997.

Those holders who convert depositary shares after March 7, 1997, will be entitled to the regular quarterly dividend on the depositary shares of $0.71875 per depositary share payable on April 1, 1997, but not to the common stock dividend payable on that date.
First Chicago NBD said it expects to send a notice of redemption to registered holders of the depositary shares on or about February 25, 1997.
